individual-data-points.explanation: Panel A shows only fluorescence micrographs (GFP, DsRed, MitoTracker, merge); no quantification plot is present.
The JC-1 relative intensity and anti-HMGB1 intensity bar charts (n=20) show only group means with error bars; no individual data points are overlaid.
Panel C is a western blot image only, with no accompanying quantification plot.
The SDH and COX signal intensity bar charts show group means with error bars and sample sizes (N) but do not display the individual data points behind the averages.

The FACS panels are frequency/histogram distribution plots (cell counts vs TMRM intensity) showing the full population distribution, a plot type exempt from requiring separately overlaid individual points.
